evidence.quote: rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on

observations.why: Establishing a recurring cadence appeals to stability and preparedness (conservation) while framing rehearsals as ongoing capability-building (competence).

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have

observations.why: The aphoristic equivalence frames unrehearsed capability as no capability at all, appealing to mastery and security simultaneously.
Restating the cadence as a structured label appeals to stability and routine as the governing good.
Assigning a named owner appeals to accountability and mastery — someone is responsible for maintaining the capability.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNoCapability
mints.title: a capability we have not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
mints.frame: Does the expression equate unrehearsed or untested capability with the absence of that capability, making rehearsal the proof of possession?
